stripe.description: Official Stripe remote MCP server (mcp.stripe.com): search and call the Stripe API (customers, payments, subscriptions, invoices, refunds), search Stripe's docs, and start a Stripe Atlas company formation (Delaware C corp or LLC). Requires a Stripe account and uses OAuth: after installing, run /mcp in Claude Code to sign in. Headless clients can send a Stripe agent API key as a Bearer token instead. Pair with the setting permissions/stripe-mcp-confirm-writes to approve writes and money movement.
